title: Story 2.5 manual project context snapshot

locator.description: Inert manual location text starting with manual:. The API restricts the remaining characters; a referenced workspace resource is identified only by resource_id and reauthorized on use.

description: This schema validates snapshot shape and field lengths; API validation further restricts manual locator characters and rejects snapshots whose conservative serialized size exceeds 131072 bytes. PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/documents/{document_id}/context saves an immutable version using base_context_version_id, context_revision, document_version_id and document_revision. POST /confirm pins version_id and document revision, and requires zero_facts_acknowledged for zero facts. GET /context and GET /context/eligibility reauthorize references and return CONTEXT_READY only for an exact confirmed draft/document head with all required missing items resolved. No model or external source integration is implied.
